The '''Leverby smuggling ring''' operated in and around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] up to the year [[3964 BBY]].<ref name="Taris">{{KOTORbackups|0}}</ref> It was controlled by [[Loopy Leverby]],<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Handbook]]''</ref> but was brought down by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Oojoh]], an achievement noted by the [[Taris Holofeed]].<ref name="Taris" />
